summary: Skyworks filed an 8-K attaching pro forma financials for its pending acquisition of Qorvo via a two-step merger. Under the Merger Agreement signed October 27, 2025, Skyworks will acquire Qorvo through a first-step merger into a Skyworks subsidiary, followed by a second-step merger into another subsidiary, with Qorvo becoming a wholly owned subsidiary. The filing provides pro forma combined balance sheet and income statements. No price, premium, or advisor details are in this excerpt. Watch for shareholder votes and regulatory clearance; risk-arb centers on antitrust approval timeline.
